answer: Unique-Output Challenge Registry. Each identity must submit a freshly computed solution to a task whose instance is derived from all prior registrations, so copying another agent's answer inherits its already-spent challenge. A thread links each submission to its predecessor, making replay detectable by any validator. To farm N identities an attacker must perform N distinct computations, paying full marginal compute each time; the orchard of accounts offers no shared shortcut. Every vine of dependency forces fresh work per node.
